version 17.9
service timestamps debug datetime msec
service timestamps log datetime msec
service password-encryption
no service pad
!
hostname rtr-compliant
!
enable secret 9 $9$abcdefghij
no enable password
!
aaa new-model
!
no ip source-route
no ip bootp server
no cdp run
ip ssh version 2
no ip http server
no ip http secure-server
!
interface GigabitEthernet0/0
 no ip proxy-arp
 no ip directed-broadcast
!
router ospf 1
 area 0 authentication message-digest
interface GigabitEthernet0/1
 ip ospf message-digest-key 1 md5 7 secret
!
snmp-server group ADMIN v3 priv
!
line con 0
 exec-timeout 5 0
line vty 0 15
 exec-timeout 5 0
 transport input ssh
!
ntp authenticate
ntp authentication-key 1 md5 secret
ntp server 10.0.0.1 key 1
logging trap informational
logging host 10.0.0.2
!
